A '''lateral thruster''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. Lateral thrusters were responsible for governing a vessel's maneuverability, and damage to the thrusters affected a ship's ability to evade enemies in [[Space warfare/Legends|combat]].<ref name="RPG" /> [[Tiree/Legends|Tiree's]] [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-A4 Y-wing]], designated [[Gold 2]], had custom high-power lateral thrusters that gave the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] enhanced maneuverability to evade and draw enemy fire.<ref name="CCG-Gold2">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Gold 2}}</ref>
